changeLog: Added bounded web layout acceptance under OWN-001. The wider Business Owner requirements and existing acceptance gaps retain their original scope and status.

requirements.requirement: Align the dashboard date, period, branch selector and scoped date range in one desktop toolbar with responsive wrapping.
requirements.uiReference: Administrator screenshot reporting misaligned date, duration, branch and scope
requirements.dataSource: Africa/Lagos dates and the authorised scope and branches returned by admin.dashboard
requirements.securityControl: Existing server authentication, branch scope and permission checks continue to govern dashboard reads and drill-downs.
negativeTests: Customer denial, cross-branch denial and invalid dashboard filters
requirements.reason: Centres align at the tested 1440px and 1728px desktop widths in both themes. Narrower widths wrap controls within the page.
requirements.testResult: PASS · Authenticated Chromium viewport and filter interaction checks plus dashboard regressions.

requirements.requirement: Use consistent KPI typography and align card heights and values within each row.
requirements.scope: Business Overview financial and operational KPI cards
requirements.uiReference: Administrator screenshot reporting inconsistent card font sizes
requirements.dataSource: admin.dashboard operational counts and verified net receipts, and business.snapshot financial totals
requirements.securityControl: Existing permission checks govern card visibility and Finance drill-downs.
negativeTests: Exclude unverified collections and preserve unavailable finance states
requirements.reason: Matching label, value and note sizes and aligned cards passed across all seven widths in both themes.
requirements.testResult: PASS · 14 authenticated Chromium layout checks and nine dashboard regressions.

gates.requirement: Desktop controls share a centre line. Responsive controls wrap without horizontal overflow. Period, branch and refresh still query the existing scoped API.
KPI typography and within-row geometry match in light and dark. Receipts remain legible and the Finance link preserves branch and period.
